description: Intentional documentation drifts seeded into a tiny FastAPI/Click project.

expected_drifts.summary: README claims `pip install tinyshop[all]` but pyproject defines no [all] extra.
README says Python 3.10+ but no minimum is set in pyproject.
README says FastAPI 0.105 but pyproject pins >=0.110.0.
README says Pydantic 1.x but pyproject pins >=2.5.0.
README says POST /products returns 200 — handler does not set status; default is 200 but on conflict raises 409, which README doesn't mention.
README says carts hold up to 50 — code has MAX_CART_ITEMS = 25.
README says cart total is in dollars — handler returns cents.
README says default currency is EUR — code DEFAULT_CURRENCY = 'USD'.
CLI README says --price is in dollars — code says price_cents int.
README says --limit defaults to 100 — code default is 50.
README says tax rate is 9% — code uses 8.25%.
README says shipping is flat $4.99 — code is 599 cents = $5.99.
README says free shipping above $100 — code uses 5000 cents = $50.
README says document tracks 0.3.1 — code is 0.4.2.
